newsitem.title: USA: Avis files for initial public stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Avis files for initial public stock offering.

text.p: Avis Rent A Car Inc., a unit of HFS Inc., has filed for an initial public offering of up to $250 million of common stock.
Avis also has applied to the New York Stock Exchange to trade under the stock symbol "AVI."

In its filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Garden City, N.Y.-based car rental company did not provide other details on the amount of stock being offered, the estimated initial price, or the number of shares outstanding after the offer.
The offer will be made through Bear, Stearns & Co. Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to repay debt and for general corporate purposes, including future acquisitions, Avis said.
After the offer is completed, HFS will own about 25 percent of Avis, and has no plans to further cut its ownership, according the filing.
